raw_segments.text: I have thought that Walden Pond would be a good place for business, not solely on account
of the railroad and the ice trade.
It offers advantages which it may not be good policy to divulge.
It is a good port and a good foundation.
No Neva marshes to be filled, though you must everywhere build on piles of your own driving.
It is said that a flood tide, with a westerly wind and ice in the Neva, would sweep St.
Petersburg from the face of the earth.
